ops.title: v12.3.0–v12.6.0 shipped: Clause.subject tuple of shapes, scope= on UsedTool+UsedSkill+UserSaid (DEFAULT turn since 12.6.0), Turn.matches, ctx.nlp, Tool.EditTools, Issue/Fix/Example review-PR template; PR #12 fully declarative via bare UserSaid(...)

ops.body:
Shipped 2026-07-20/21. **v12.3.0** live on PyPI (tag `a6124563`, Release run green): the NLP/condition API-surface wave, user-directed mid-flight (tuple pivot arrived as a mid-turn message).

- **`Clause.subject` is a tuple of allowed subject shapes** — `()` default (no constraint), kinds `"unnamed"` | `"passive"` | `"actor"` classified by the exported `subject_kind(tok)`; bare string normalizes to a singleton in `__post_init__` (deliberate: neutralizes the `("unnamed")` missing-comma typo). Replaces `"any"/"no_nominal"/"none"`; old `"none"` → `("unnamed",)`, old `"no_nominal"` → `("unnamed", "passive")` (tombstones). User rejected two rounds of literal renames ("still not completely clear") before proposing the tuple themselves — for shape-taste questions, offer the *structural* alternative early, not just better names.
- **New public surfaces**: `UsedTool(*names, subagents=True, scope="session"|"turn")` in types.py (turn scope = compliance-skip idiom); `UserSaid(*patterns)` takes case-insensitive regex strings and/or Clauses, root-exported now; `evt.ctx.turn` returns `Turn` (captain_hook/turn.py, a `Session` subclass with `matches(*patterns)`); `evt.ctx.nlp(text, *patterns)` escape hatch. All share `scan_text` (private, signals/nlp.py). Export additions need EXPORTS + `__init__.pyi` + PINNED_EXPORTS (test_public_api) + the great-docs fragment (`.claude/fragments/great-docs.yml/great-docs-local.fragment.yml`) + `cc-guides render`.
- **`cc-guides render` re-renders ALL fragment artifacts** — CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md/.mcp.json picked up foreign fragment drift; commit only great-docs.yml + fragment + cc-guides.lock, leave the rest for the Guides CI re-render bot.
- **PR #12** force-pushed as `74621c15` (= main + one plans.py commit): clauses inlined in `StopAndReplanDirective.check` via `evt.ctx.turn.matches(...)`, `skip_if=[UsedTool("EnterPlanMode", scope="turn")]`, zero private imports; 8/8 inline tests. User: no constants without cause — inline single-use tuples into the method.
- `subject="any"` default question answered NO (kept `()` ≡ any): tombstones-style description clauses need named subjects; constraint stays opt-in.
- Probe caveat: "come back to planning first" ("planning" parses VERB/pcomp) and "halt work …" ("halt work" parses as compound noun) miss with or without subject constraints — en_core_web_sm anchor quirks, not subject-logic bugs.

**v12.4.0** followed (tag `e8f25ed3`, release green): `Tool.EditTools` — ClassVar annotation in the body, `Tool.EditTools = Tool("Edit", "MultiEdit", "NotebookEdit", "Write")` assigned after the class (no aliasing exists among edit tools — Edit ≠ MultiEdit ≠ NotebookEdit; only Bash/Execute, Write/Create, Agent/Task, WebFetch/FetchUrl, ExitPlanMode/ExitSpecMode alias) — adopted by scratch_writes, rewrite_code, and the PR #12 hook. Review-pipeline PRs now open with an **Issue/Fix/Example** body (evidence quotes woven into Issue, transcript vignette as Example): the template is prose in `captain_hook/skills/scanning-sessions/references/pr-workflow.md` — the brain LLM follows it and runs `gh pr create` itself; no Python or test pins the body. The `gen:conditions` table in the authoring-hooks skill is generated from `CONDITION_DESCRIPTIONS` in tests/test_skill_docs.py (`uv run python -m tests.test_skill_docs` regenerates); hand-edits inside gen markers get overwritten, and new TCondition members MUST get a descriptions entry or test_skill_docs fails CI. `Turn` had to leave test_import_surface.py's LEGACY_SURFACE tombstone. PR #12 final: `58c8ddef`, only_if=[Tool.EditTools, StopAndReplanDirective()].

**v12.5.0** followed (tag `4b205c2c`, release green, PyPI live): user asked why PR #12 didn't use `UserSaid` — answer was its session-wide scan — then directed `scope=` onto "all the Used*". `UsedSkill(*names, scope=)` and `UserSaid(*patterns, scope=)` now mirror `UsedTool` (default `"session"` keeps existing semantics; `UserSaid(scope="turn")` ≡ `evt.ctx.turn.matches`). `has_used_skill`/`has_tool` recurse sidechains **by path**, so turn scope + `subagents=True` still sees all session sidechains — pre-existing `UsedTool` behavior, deliberately mirrored. PR #12 final: `24b0c3b4` (= v12.5.0 main + one plans.py commit), `StopAndReplanDirective` deleted, clauses inline in `only_if=[Tool.EditTools, UserSaid(…, scope="turn")]`; 234/234 general-pack inline tests. Gotcha: `gh run list --commit <short-sha>` silently returns empty — use the full sha or `--limit` + filter.

**v12.6.0** (tag `11b9e365`): **BREAKING — `scope=` defaults to `"turn"` across UsedSkill/UsedTool/UserSaid** (user: "both should default to turn"); `scope="session"` is the explicit opt-in. Call-site judgments: python/go commit-gates' bare `UserSaid("commit", "just commit")` deliberately moved to turn (stale exemptions shouldn't disarm the gate); `docs/_fragments/canonical_hook.py` + `docs/examples/failure_recovery.py` mean "this session" and now say `scope="session"` explicitly. Gotchas: `make_messages_ctx` does NOT wire `ctx.turn` (MagicMock) — turn-default conditions need `build_ctx(transcript=make_transcript(raw_text("user", ...), ...))`; `tests/test_daemon_server.py` `TestNonStrSessionId::test_non_str_session_id_dispatch_matches_cold` fails locally even on clean main (env-only, CI green) and `TestConcurrency` flakes under full-suite load. PR #12 final tip: `a172d624` = main + one plans.py commit, bare `UserSaid(...)`/`UsedTool("EnterPlanMode")` spellings, 234/234 general-pack inline tests. The v12.5.0 wave was shipped by a PARALLEL session mid-conversation — it moved the shared nlp-api-wt worktree (58c8ddef → 24b0c3b4) between two of this session's tool calls; always re-check a shared worktree's HEAD right before using it.

Supersedes the UserSaid-is-keyword-only note in [[pr12-stop-replan-cleanup-shipped]].
